description: Text similarity and overlap check (offline) — Compare two texts offline: term-frequency cosine, word-set Jaccard, shingle overlap (how much of a appears word-for-word in b and vice versa), longest common word run and the shared passages. Verdict IDENTICAL / NEAR_DUPLICATE / HIGH_OVERLAP / PARTIAL_OVERLAP / SIMILAR / RELATED / DIFFERENT with a 0-100 score. Use it for duplicate detection, copy/plagiarism screening, or checking a rewrite. a and b up to 20,000 characters each; optional shingle (2-10 words, default 5). Lexical, not semantic; for meaning use /v1/ai/similarity. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).

a.description: e.g. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the river bank today.

b.description: e.g. Today the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the old mill.

name: text_similarity
